<p class="bms-glossary-aliases"><strong>Also called:</strong> <span id="alias-decline-a-double">Decline a Double</span>, <span id="alias-drop">Drop</span>, <span id="alias-fold">Fold</span>, <span id="alias-refuse">Refuse</span>, <span id="alias-refuse-a-double">Refuse a Double</span></p>
